subject: Entity decommissioning & temporary invoice forwarding for Verdant Therapeutics
messages:
From: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@verdant.so>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@verdant.so
Date: 2026-11-01T09:02:00Z
Subject: Upcoming legal entity decommissioning — invoice routing while we transition

Hi Jonas,

Quick heads up from Finance at Verdant — we are decommissioning one of our legacy billing entities (Verdant R&D LLC) effective Nov 15 while we move invoices to the parent (Verdant Therapeutics, Inc.). During the two-week migration window AP will re-route invoice approvals to a central queue.

Could you confirm whether Redwood can temporarily: 1) accept invoices billed to Verdant R&D LLC but have payments remitted to the parent entity, and 2) accept a one-time signed addendum that authorizes the remit change for outstanding invoices through Nov 30?

Attached is the official decommission notice and our AP remit template. We need to finish the Nov cycle by Nov 12 so any routing guidance or a short checklist from your side would help.

Thanks — cc'ing our AP inbox so they can track any invoice replies.

Best,
Aisha Qureshi
Head of Finance Operations
Verdant Therapeutics
attachments: Verdant_entity_decommission_notice.pdf, Verdant_AP_remit_update_template.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@verdant.so>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, accounts-payable@verdant.so
Date: 2026-11-01T11:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Upcoming legal entity decommissioning — invoice routing while we transition

Hi Aisha — thanks for the heads up and the docs.

Short answer: yes, we can support the temporary remit routing you describe. To make this operational we need two things from Verdant: (A) a signed service addendum that authorizes payment routing to Verdant Therapeutics, Inc. for invoices issued to Verdant R&D LLC through Nov 30, and (B) a primary AP contact for any payment exceptions.

Operational notes / proposed checklist for the Nov cycle:
- You send signed addendum (Doc attached to your original message) — we countersign and return via DocuSign.
- AP emails invoices to billing@redwood.ai with the legacy entity visible on the invoice.
- Finance team flags any tax/VAT differences in the invoice metadata; we will not alter invoice legal name, only remit instructions.
- Payments issued to Verdant Therapeutics, Inc. will include a remit reference matching the invoice number.

I’ve looped in Marissa (billing lead) and Karthik (tax) to confirm the tax/VAT treatment and the internal ops steps. If you’re good with that flow, please send the signed addendum and the AP single-point-of-contact.

Cheers,
Jonas
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@verdant.so>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, accounts-payable@verdant.so
Date: 2026-11-01T13:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Upcoming legal entity decommissioning — invoice routing while we transition

Thanks for the context. Operational confirmations from Redwood billing:

1) We will accept scanned/emailed invoices that list Verdant R&D LLC as the billed entity, provided the invoice number and PO (if present) are intact.
2) Payments will be remitted to the parent entity bank details once we receive the signed addendum. We will add an internal remit flag to the invoice record to ensure AP links payment to the originating invoice.
3) Please note: if any invoice contains VAT that was computed under the legacy entity's VAT registration, Karthik will review and follow up on whether a credit memo is required after the migration.

Action requested for Verdant: please upload the signed_service_addendum_20261102.pdf (we can also accept DocuSign). Also confirm the AP contact for exception handling (name + direct phone).

- Marissa
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@verdant.so>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@verdant.so
Date: 2026-11-02T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Upcoming legal entity decommissioning — invoice routing while we transition

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Attached: signed_service_addendum_20261102.pdf (signed by Verdant legal). AP contact is Priya Menon (pri.menon@verdant.so | +1-415-555-0199). We will route all invoices to billing@redwood.ai with the legacy entity name on the invoice and include a header line: "Remit to: Verdant Therapeutics, Inc."

One note on VAT: Verdant's EU subsidiary will not be part of this decommission; these invoices are US-only. Karthik, happy to provide the VAT registration docs for anything you need.

Regards,
Aisha
attachments: signed_service_addendum_20261102.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@verdant.so>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Upcoming legal entity decommissioning — invoice routing while we transition

Hi all — thanks for the clarification, Aisha. For the US invoices this is straightforward: since the billed legal entity remains visible on the invoice (Verdant R&D LLC) but remit is to the parent, we will not alter tax treatment. A few quick points: 
- We will tag invoices that indicate any state sales tax line items and flag for a second review.
- For any credit memo requests related to VAT/registrations we will coordinate with your EU contacts, but you mentioned EU is out of scope for this change.

Marissa — once you receive the signed addendum I’ll mark the remit exception in our system so payments will process to the parent bank account through Nov 30.

Karthik
Senior Tax Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@verdant.so>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, accounts-payable@verdant.so
Date: 2026-11-03T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Upcoming legal entity decommissioning — invoice routing while we transition

All set on our side — we received Verdant's signed addendum and countersigned it (attached). Operational notes for AP:
- Send invoices to billing@redwood.ai with the invoice PDF and the PO number in the subject.
- Include the remit header as discussed.
- Exceptions (tax lines, missing PO, incorrect invoice number) go to pri.menon@verdant.so and billing-disputes@redwood.ai.

We’ve updated the internal remit flag for Verdant: payments issued for invoices dated on or before 2026-11-30 and billed to Verdant R&D LLC will be remitted to Verdant Therapeutics, Inc. bank account on file. Karthik confirmed no EU VAT impact.

Closing this ticket on our side; please let us know immediately if AP has trouble routing the Nov cycle.

Thanks,
Marissa
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: countersigned_service_addendum_20261103.pdf
